requirements.sourceQuote: Applicants are expected to hold an excellent Master’s degree (or equivalent) from a wide spectrum of potential disciplines such as cognitive neuroscience, computational neuroscience, translational neuroscience, psychology, medicine, neurobiology, computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, neuroimaging, biochemistry, or related fields.
The Master’s degree should have been awarded by an internationally recognised university.
Research experience in an area that is related to the scope of IMPRS CoNI is essential for successful candidates.
